description:
The AI ecosystem is being redrawn in real time. The person who wins this role won't just watch it happen. They'll be the one shaping where Delight.ai sits inside it.
  The Company
 Sendbird is on a mission to build the AI workforce of tomorrow. For over a decade, we built the infrastructure behind conversations—chat, voice, video, messaging APIs—and became the #1 CPaaS platform for in-app communications. 4,000+ brands trust us. 7 billion messages flow through our platform every month. 300 million monthly active users.
 We powered conversations for DoorDash, Match Group, Noom, Yahoo Sports, Rakuten, and thousands of others. We were good at what we did. Really good.
 We also saw it early: AI would fundamentally reshape how businesses talk to customers. The infrastructure we'd spent a decade building would become commoditized. The value would move up the stack—into intelligence, into experience, into outcomes.
 We had a choice: protect what we built, or reinvent ourselves.
 We chose reinvention.
 In December 2024, we made the full strategic pivot to AI-first customer experience. By February 2025, we'd launched our AI agent for enterprise CX—built on a decade of conversation data, now with intelligence on top. And in November 2025, we rebranded to Delight.ai.
 The name says it all. AI's real promise isn't efficiency or cost savings. It's giving customers back something they lost—the feeling of being truly understood and cared for. Not satisfied. Delighted.
  The Product
 Delight.ai is the AI concierge for customer experience. Most AI agents forget you the moment the conversation ends. Ours doesn't. Delight.ai builds memory over time, learns preferences, and connects context across every channel—chat, SMS, email, voice, WhatsApp—without losing the thread. We're building AI that makes customers feel understood, seen, and remembered.
  Why Head of Strategic Partnerships & AI Ecosystem
 The AI platform wars are being fought at the ecosystem layer. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and AWS are competing to become the default infrastructure for enterprise AI, and the companies that secure the right positions inside those ecosystems now will compound that advantage for years. Delight.ai is already in the race. We need someone to make sure we're winning it.
 This isn't merely a role for someone who manages relationships. It's for someone who builds leverage, moves fast with AI tools to operationalize partnership motions, and treats ecosystem positioning the way a product leader treats roadmap.
  The Role
 Reporting to the CRO, you will own Delight.ai's full ISV and hyperscaler ecosystem strategy, from AWS co-sell execution to GenAI platform alliances with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Build the commercial engine that makes partnerships a measurable, compounding revenue driver. This role is built for someone who moves fast, uses AI to do the work of a full team, and treats every partnership as a distribution play.
  You might be this person if:
 
  You reach for AI tools to automate the operational overhead of partnership work: pipeline tracking, enablement, reporting, outreach.
  You think about ecosystem strategy the way an engineer thinks about architecture: modular, scalable, with clear interfaces between components.
  You know the difference between a partner that looks good on a slide and one that actually moves pipeline.
  You can walk into a room with a CTO, a hyperscaler field rep, and a CFO and speak credibly to all three.
  You get restless when processes are manual. If something is done by hand more than twice, you're already automating it.
  You track the AI ecosystem obsessively, not just the headline players but emerging ones, integration models, and commercial structures that are starting to win.
  You can point to partner-sourced or partner-influenced ARR with your fingerprints on it.
 
 You need to have:
 
  10+ years in Strategic Partnerships, Technology Alliances, or Ecosystem Leadership inside SaaS or enterprise technology.
  Deep hands-on experience with hyperscalers, especially AWS co-sell programs, and direct relationships with GenAI platform vendors.
  Technical fluency to engage product and engineering leaders, plus commercial acumen to structure and close complex partnership agreements.
  Proven, quantifiable revenue impact through partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  Experience designing and scaling a global partnerships operating model, including segmentation, tiering, and performance frameworks.
 
 What you'll actually do:
